title.zh: 实验需要返回：相对于确定性，记录恰在取过之处固定一个动作的结果；自己的动作若换一个会怎样，只在配置返回之处被固定；保留历史的运行永不返回，所以实验需要一个关于何者无关的模型
title.en: Experiment needs return: relative to determinacy, the record fixes a move's outcome exactly where it was taken; what one's act would have done otherwise is fixed only where the configuration returns; a kept history never returns, so experiment needs a model of what is irrelevant

claim.zh: 设 r 是过程 P 的一个运行。相对于确定性，直到某步的记录把动作 a 在配置 s 的结果固定为 u，是指容许 r 在该步之前每一步的每个确定过程都把 a 在 s 送到 u（Run.Fixes）。运行在某步之前取过 a 于 s，记录就把它固定为运行所到之处（Run.fixes_of_takes）；P 确定、有两个不同的配置而运行没有取过 a 于 s 时，记录不固定它的任何结果，无论什么被识：把 a 在 s 改送到任一配置、其余不变的过程仍确定，并容许运行的每一步（retarget、retarget_determined、Run.stepsOf_retarget、Run.not_fixes_of_untaken）。所以在配置返回之处，另一个动作的结果被固定（Run.fixes_on_return）；配置永不返回的运行，在经过的每个配置只固定它所取的动作（Run.not_fixes_other_of_new）。保留其所经配置与动作之历史的过程（keepHistory，Law.withHistory 带动作的对应）中，历史每步长一，所以每步都是新的（keepHistory_length、keepHistory_new），确定性保持（keepHistory_determined），关于自己的动作除了所做的什么都不固定（keepHistory_fixes_nothing_else）。经投影 π 读：运行取过 a 于投影为 k 的配置，经投影的记录固定其结果（Run.fixesThrough_of_takes）；P 的步经 π 分解为确定过程 Q 时（FactorsThrough），所固定的结果就是投影为 k 的每个配置经 π 的结果，无论运行是否经过它（Run.generalizes）；有限多个投影配置之内，投影从每一步起都返回（Run.projection_returns，revisits_from 的实例）。Confound 中配置是一个隐藏位与一个结果，每步翻转隐藏位、把结果设为步前的隐藏位，动作不造成差别（Confound.move_idle）；只读结果时，直到第二步的记录固定左得假、右得真（Confound.misattributes）；动作与隐藏位同步时，“动作决定结果”的确定模型在每一步都容许投影各步（Confound.confounded）；在隐藏位与第一步不同之处再向左，没有确定过程容许直到第五步的投影各步（Confound.varied_refutes）。不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Let r be a run of a process P. Relative to determinacy, the record up to a step fixes the outcome of move a at configuration s to u when every determined process admitting each step of r before it sends a at s to u (Run.Fixes). Once the run has taken a at s, the record fixes it to where the run went (Run.fixes_of_takes); where P is determined, there are two different configurations and the run has not taken a at s, the record fixes no outcome of it, whatever registers: the process sending a at s to any configuration and otherwise as P is still determined and admits every step of the run (retarget, retarget_determined, Run.stepsOf_retarget, Run.not_fixes_of_untaken). So where the configuration returns, another move's outcome is fixed (Run.fixes_on_return), and a run whose configurations never return fixes, at each configuration it passes, no move other than the one it takes (Run.not_fixes_other_of_new). In the process keeping the history of configurations and moves passed through (keepHistory, the counterpart with moves of Law.withHistory) the past grows by one at each step, so every step is new (keepHistory_length, keepHistory_new), determinacy is kept (keepHistory_determined), and nothing about one's own acts but what one did is fixed (keepHistory_fixes_nothing_else). Read through a projection π: once the run has taken a at a configuration projecting to k, the record so read fixes its outcome (Run.fixesThrough_of_takes); where P's step factors through π into a determined process (FactorsThrough), the fixed outcome is the outcome, read through π, at every configuration projecting to k, passed by the run or not (Run.generalizes); within finitely many projected configurations the projection returns from every step on (Run.projection_returns, an instance of revisits_from). In Confound the configuration is a hidden bit and an outcome, each step flips the hidden bit and sets the outcome to the hidden bit before the step, and the move makes no difference (Confound.move_idle); read through the outcome, the record up to the second step fixes left to false and right to true (Confound.misattributes); with the moves in step with the hidden bit, the determined model in which the move decides the outcome admits the projected steps at every step (Confound.confounded); moving left again where the hidden bit differs from the first step, no determined process admits the projected steps up to the fifth (Confound.varied_refutes). No Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 固定相对于确定性：比较的是容许记录的确定过程类（Joint.Determined），不是对展开的假设；“未取的不被固定”另要实际过程确定、有两个不同的配置。
hypotheses.en: Fixing is relative to determinacy: the comparison is over the class of determined processes admitting the record (Joint.Determined), not an assumption about the unfolding; “an untaken move is not fixed” further needs the actual process determined and two different configurations.

hypotheses.zh: 投影是模型（FactorsThrough），由运行之外给出；有限多个投影配置是写在 projection_returns 中的条件。
hypotheses.en: The projection is a model (FactorsThrough), supplied from outside the run; finitely many projected configurations is the condition written into projection_returns.

hypotheses.zh: 见证的结论：Confound 的过程与运行。
hypotheses.en: For the witness: Confound's process and runs.

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；配置与动作是任意类型。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; configurations and moves of any type.

correspondence.zh: P49 留下的开放项（审查 F6）：一个动作造成什么，是有与无此动作的两段历史的比较。Ren 在 P49 落地后写“land and merge all, then continue”，看过结果后写“no extra review needed, merge, then continue”。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：实验是在配置（按实验者的读法）返回之处变动自己的动作；重复是这一返回；对照是步骤经读法分解的模型；与略去者无关的变动是随机化的结构形式；以 P49 的识为读法，阈下与所及之外的不见是不分解的情形。见整合文档 §72。
correspondence.en: P49's open item (review F6): what an act does compares the history with it and the history without it. After P49 landed Ren wrote “land and merge all, then continue”, and on the result “no extra review needed, merge, then continue”. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): an experiment is varying one's own act where the configuration, as the experimenter reads it, returns; replication is that return; a control is the model that the step factors through the reading; variation independent of what is left out is the structural form of randomization; with P49's registration as the reading, threshold and reach blindness are cases where the step does not factor. See §72 of the integration note.

detail.zh: 复用 Determined：动作决定一步。这里问记录在何处固定动作所造成的；Joint 问一个部分是否造成差别。
detail.en: Reuses Determined: the move determines the step. Here the question is where the record fixes what a move does; Joint asks whether a part makes the difference.

detail.zh: 复用 revisits_from（投影的返回）与 Law.withHistory 的形式（带动作的 keepHistory）。
detail.en: Reuses revisits_from (the projection's return) and the form of Law.withHistory (keepHistory with moves).

output.zh: 有限多个配置之内的返回；保留的历史永不返回。
output.en: Return within finitely many configurations; a kept history never returns.

input.zh: 投影的返回；保留历史者只固定所做的。
input.en: The projection's return; a kept history fixes only what was done.

detail.zh: 推进 P49 的开放项：一个动作造成什么只相对于模型才可检验（Flow.beyond_needs_model）；这里给出展开自身在何处固定它，所需的模型是确定性加一次返回，或一个投影。
detail.en: Advances P49's open item: what an act does is testable only relative to a model (Flow.beyond_needs_model); here the unfolding itself fixes it where it returns, the model needed being determinacy with one return, or a projection.

output.zh: 一个动作的检验需要模型。
output.en: Testing an act needs a model.

detail.zh: 这一开放目标的一个部分：在脊柱上陈述实验、重复与对照的结构条件；不确立整个目标。
detail.en: One part of this open target: the structural conditions of experiment, replication and control, stated on the spine; it does not establish the whole target.

detail.zh: 外围的信息界；这里在脊柱上：记录在何处固定动作的结果。
detail.en: The periphery's information bound; here on the spine: where the record fixes what an act does.

detail.zh: 那里交换随识时阈下的差别保持；这里，以识为投影，阈下的不见是步骤不经所识者分解的情形（读法）。
detail.en: There a difference below the threshold stays where the exchange follows registration; here, with registration as the projection, blindness below the threshold is a case where the step does not factor through what registers (a reading).

detail.zh: 错误的投影误归因而永不被否证：Confound 中动作不造成差别，只读结果时记录固定左得假、右得真；动作与隐藏位同步时，“动作决定结果”的确定模型在每一步都被容许（Confound.misattributes、Confound.confounded）。只有与隐藏位错开的动作否证它（Confound.varied_refutes）。
detail.en: A wrong projection misattributes and is never refuted: in Confound the move makes no difference, yet read through the outcome the record fixes left to false and right to true, and with the moves in step with the hidden bit the determined model in which the move decides the outcome is admitted at every step (Confound.misattributes, Confound.confounded). Only moves varied against the hidden bit refute it (Confound.varied_refutes).

limitations.zh: 形成变动其动作、保留或遗忘其历史、形成投影都不推出；实际展开经哪个投影分解是经验问题；随机或不确定的过程没有陈述；全配置的返回在实际中罕见，正面结果实际上都经投影；与 Becoming.Testing 的识的形式桥接没有陈述；动作与隐藏者的何种相关使模型永不被否证，一般形式没有陈述；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: That a formation varies its acts, keeps or forgets its history, or forms a projection is not derived; which projection the actual unfolding factors through is empirical; random or undetermined processes are not treated; whole configurations rarely return in practice, so the positive results in practice go through projections; the formal bridge to Becoming.Testing's registration is not stated; the general form of which correlation between moves and what is hidden leaves a model unrefuted is not stated; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; contains no ethical predicate.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T084405.661795Z）：Becoming.Experiment 的 25 项定理全部空依赖，其中含 Run.fixes_of_takes、Run.not_fixes_of_untaken、keepHistory_fixes_nothing_else、Run.generalizes 与 Confound.varied_refutes；同一回执覆盖包内 61 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 3114 项定理／4559 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261013T084521.070057Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 63 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §72；按 Ren 的“no extra review needed”不作独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T084405.661795Z): the 25 theorems of Becoming.Experiment all have empty axiom reports, among them Run.fixes_of_takes, Run.not_fixes_of_untaken, keepHistory_fixes_nothing_else, Run.generalizes and Confound.varied_refutes; the same receipt covers the package's 61 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 3114 theorems/4559 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T084521.070057Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 63 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §72 of the integration note; at Ren's “no extra review needed” there is no independent review.

next_delta.zh: 以 Becoming.Testing 的识为投影的形式桥接（对任一投影，P66 给出条件：恰在投影相同的配置同去时，有确定过程经它容许如此读的每一步，carries_law_iff；P73 给出观察到的结果何时正确转移：恰在两个配置经投影以该动作同去之处，transfer_right_iff）；动作与隐藏者的何种相关使模型永不被否证的一般形式；动作中被遗忘的部分造成差别时的实验（P68：遗忘噪声后，标准模型恰在噪声不造成差别时确定，forget_inputs_determined_iff）。
next_delta.en: The formal bridge with Becoming.Testing's registration as the projection (for any projection P66 states the condition: some determined process through it admits every step so read exactly where configurations alike under it go alike, carries_law_iff; P73 states when an observed outcome transfers rightly: exactly where the two configurations go alike under the projection by the move, transfer_right_iff); the general form of which correlation between moves and what is hidden leaves a model unrefuted; experiment where a forgotten part of the move makes a difference (P68: with the noise forgotten, the standard model is determined exactly where the noise makes no difference, forget_inputs_determined_iff).
